integrity: All core universal statements use a complete analytic proof; a standalone finite checker is supplementary. Root count and fold are algebraically equivalent to a shifted-coupling antiphase fixed-point calculation and are not claimed independently novel. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The global basin partition applies to the invariant antidiagonal only. Off-antidiagonal orbits are not classified. The parameter band is strict and assumes 0<a<1 in exact real arithmetic; publication-priority uncertainty remains for unindexed work.
title: Bistable coexistence and an exact antidiagonal basin separator in a coupled Gaussian map
